THE COUNT WEARS THE LOOP, THE LADDER STAYS AN OPEN ARC
A seed pasted here replays a reading already declared elsewhere; CAST strikes a new one instead, the exact instant of the touch its only chance, the same way the Wayfinder's own hand commits. Either way the seed is shown, never hidden, so it can be kept. The pale light, when shown, is the sky, never a card. The camera turns to meet a cast once on its own; a hand on the toroid always takes the wheel back.
